title: Greenhouse Seven
author: penny_dragon
summary: “Let me,” Pansy said, placing her hand on top of his, gently taking the knife from him. The warmth of her touch spread up his arm, across his chest. It was the first time she’d intentionally touched him.He watched as she pulled a new flower from the basket. Her brow furrowed as she made the first cut. “Like this?” Neville didn’t answer right away. His eyes flicked from the flower to her hands, noting the way she held the blade too delicately, as if afraid to ruin the petal. “Almost,” he murmured, standing now, his chest nearly pressed into her shoulder. He reached out, adjusting her grip, his fingers curling over hers. A chill went up his arm. “Let the blade do the work.” Pansy stilled, the warmth of her body just a breath away. She didn’t move, didn’t pull away. He felt her pulse against his fingers, steady but strong. Then, slowly, she pressed the knife down. The petal split cleanly. Neville let go, a small smile on his face. “Yeah, just like that.” She exhaled, something small and satisfied, and met his eyes for the first time since she’d walked in. Something passed between them then, something quiet, something neither of them said out loud.

title: How Villains Are Made

As old truths surface, Draco must decide if love is a weakness or the only thing worth saving. title: Unfortunately Yours
author: Ivy_Wild
summary: ***** NOW COMPLETE *****Ten years after the war, Hermione Granger has built a life on purpose: a brilliant career, more projects than hours in the day, and a future carefully unburdened by expectations. Draco Malfoy has done the opposite—running from his legacy, his family’s obligations, and a marriage contract he REALLY does not want to fulfill. A chance encounter at a gala at Malfoy Manor binds them together in a way neither of them chose—and neither of them can undo. An accidental marriage becomes something far more dangerous: a slow unraveling of old wounds, unavoidable desire, and a bond rooted in ancient magic that refuses to be broken easily. As Hermione and Draco search for a way out, they uncover a story buried deep in the Malfoy line—a tragedy of love, betrayal, and sacrifice that may hold the key to their freedom… or doom them to repeat it. Enemies bound by circumstance. Lovers bound by magic.And a question neither of them can escape: what if the cost of breaking the bond is more than they can bear? Accidental marriage. Slow emotional burn. Sharp banter, dangerous magic, and a lesson in accepting the love you think you don’t deserve.
